summary: WorldEntity generation-10 retains strong hostile-ID execution fences but its canonical identity predicate still accepts arbitrary printable strings instead of authenticating the project StableId v1 contract. Draft PR #491 records the non-duplicate contract gap and the required compatibility decision without changing source or claiming Hero Gate engine evidence.
evidence: Audited retained WorldEntity PR #477 exact head fdd5bbe85f0f813172cb5b1e8564550b9c9beb96.
WorldEntity.isId() accepts any non-empty string up to 256 bytes without control characters; WorldEntity construction/ownership and registry lookup/mutation fences use that predicate.

Docs/ARCHITECTURE.md states WorldEntityId is supplied by the project StableId contract, while Docs/DETERMINISM_CONTRACT.md fixes StableId v1 text to <namespace>:v1:<32 lowercase hex digits> and StableId.is() exposes that validator.

PhysicsLabRecipe already creates canonical entity IDs with StableId.fromParts("entity", ...), so the permanent Hero Gate fixture follows the stronger identity contract while the WorldEntity boundary itself does not authenticate it.

Merged PR #282 tightened aliases inside DeterminismContract.isStableId(); this finding is distinct because WorldEntity does not invoke the canonical validator. PR #378's hostile/non-string registry fence is also distinct because it uses the permissive WorldEntity.isId() predicate.

Existing WorldEntity tests contain readable legacy-shaped IDs such as entity:0000000000000001, so source tightening requires an explicit namespace/legacy compatibility decision rather than an unreviewed validator swap.
Docs-only PR #491 exact head 2951a627d7f327013bb1daee81e2d44dae6102c3 records the repro, non-duplication analysis, compatibility caution, and focused Pure Luau regression targets.

metadata.recommendedNext: Keep PR #491 docs-only. After the retained WorldEntity lineage is synchronized, explicitly decide whether WorldEntity requires StableId namespace entity, any canonical project StableId namespace, or a bounded legacy compatibility path; then materialize one narrow source+Pure-Luau leaf without rewriting StableId v1 bytes or weakening existing hostile-ID, duplicate, lifecycle, and budget fences.
